name: Improved Totemic Alignment (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Barbarian 6, must possess the totemic sage archetype.

Benefit: Whenever you enter a rage while bound to a spirit that belongs to your associated constellation, you may select 1 constellation aspect and gain its benefits for the duration of the rage. You are treated as an occultist with a level equal to your barbarian level for the purpose of this constellation aspect.
